objective: Accurate, beautiful global regional coverage across plants, wildlife, ground appearance, and ordinary regional architecture
coverageLevel: Global habitat and construction-family coverage with bounded procedural detail; the fidelity limits below remain explicit.

deliverables: composable regional content with independent ecological and architectural channels

subgridRegions: Southeast US mixed woodlands and savannas
atlas.interpretation: Potential habitat only. Actual terrain land cover controls placement. Uncovered cells remain identifiable. No claim of species presence.

composition: versioned regional modules with explicit dependency/override resolution
independent ecological and architectural selection per point
worker parity and content-hash cache identity
per-vertex regional ground palettes on semantic surfaces and bare/distant terrain, with host override precedence
protected-area designations preserve underlying physical habitat and remain available for wildlife context

plants.delivery: data recipes with opaque procedural near/medium/far geometry, no plant GLB downloads
plants.mappedTrees: source species/genus and measured dimensions take precedence; otherwise use compatible local park trees
plants.cultivation: world-anchored rows, nine observed crop types, crop/trees/irrigated source metadata
plants.habitatContext: water-proximity requirements, preserved dry island holes, coastal mangrove and riparian gating
plants.seasonality: explicit month, hemisphere/latitude deciduous calendar, 30 derived spring/autumn/winter presets, stable plant positions; neutral tropical and evergreen appearance

architecture.selection: mapped use and dimensions before neighborhood inference; named precedents remain explicit
architecture.entrances: bounded single/double/service facade entrances, reserved ground-floor bays, structural-opening and raised-building precedence; visual, not traversable interiors
architecture.geography: Natural Earth 1:50m 5.1.1 exterior outlines, simplified at 0.02 degrees, 241 country/territory features; bounded 2.5 km nearest-outline fallback for uncovered coastal gaps

wildlife.rangeSource: Mammal Diversity Database v2.5, CC BY 4.0
wildlife.rangeGrid: Natural Earth 50m map units, quarter-degree centers, 247 countries/territories
wildlife.simulation: 20 Hz deterministic bounded wandering with per-step habitat/range checks
wildlife.rendering: shared procedural opaque skinned geometry, one draw per visible animal, near/medium/far
wildlife.integration: mountEarthView and World Explorer, finest displayed landcover/features, shared water datum, independent budgets, disposal
wildlife.sound: existing generic birds/crickets gated by habitat and season; no species recording claims

Final pnpm verify passed, including 2,677 Vitest tests plus Node suites and source/schema checks. pnpm smoke:packed passed with 16 tarballs and seven scaffolded/checked/tested/built templates. pnpm docs:site:check passed. pnpm test:golden passed with 47 tests and ten environment-dependent WebGPU-related skips.

Local review gallery contains 150 captures, with functional category and text filters; live and controlled evidence remain labeled separately. All captured artifacts stay local and no generated GLBs were added to Git or uploaded.
fidelityLimits: Quarter-degree ecology is a potential-habitat prior, not present-day vegetation mapping. Four small source regions remain below grid resolution; detailed transitions require finer local evidence.
Named mammals use native-country limits plus biome and actual habitat, not detailed occupancy maps. Migration, sex/age variation, social herds and species-specific audio are not modeled.
Thirteen construction families are broad visual priors, not a survey of individual buildings, local heritage or every city's rural/urban distribution. Missing mapped footprints are not invented.
Mapped crops and coarse deciduous seasons are supported; richer irrigation, agricultural calendars and seasonal drying of waterways need additional source evidence.

Headless Chromium timing is evidence for this machine only; high-detail Kyoto/Seattle views can retain approximately 1 GiB of geometry, so lower quality/adaptive budgets remain necessary on smaller devices.
observedAdjacentIssues: The Tucson public-mount driving capture showed the sedan partially below a sloped road surface after acceleration. Regional terrain and vegetation rendered correctly; vehicle/road grounding needs a separate navigation fix.
